analysis.originalLogic: In `KnownPanicsLint`'s `Value::get_const`, the `(PlaceElem::Index(idx), Value::Aggregate { fields, .. })` branch reads the index as a target `usize`, converts it to `u32` via `try_into`, then constructs `FieldIdx::from_u32(...)` and looks up the aggregate field, defaulting to `Value::Uninit` when the field is absent.
analysis.incorrectTransformation: The historical code treated any index convertible to `u32` as a valid `FieldIdx` without checking `FieldIdx`'s representable range. `FieldIdx::from_u32` asserts `value <= 0xFFFF_FF00`, so large constant indices (for example `u32::MAX`) caused an assertion failure/ICE. The corrected transformation checks `idx <= FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32` before calling `FieldIdx::from_u32`; out-of-range indices return `None` instead of constructing an invalid `FieldIdx`.
analysis.inputDomain: Constant indexing of an aggregate/array in MIR as processed by `KnownPanicsLint`, where `prop.get_const` resolves the index to a target `usize`. The failing subset is an index greater than `FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32` (`0xFFFF_FF00`) but still convertible to `u32`, up to and including `u32::MAX`; the regression uses `u32::MAX as usize - 1` (4294967294) on a 64-bit test target. Indices above `u32::MAX` fail the earlier `try_into::<u32>` conversion and do not reach the `FieldIdx::from_u32` assertion.
analysis.summary: Bug fix in `KnownPanicsLint`: guard `PlaceElem::Index` constants before converting them to `FieldIdx`. Indices above `FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32` (but representable as `u32`) previously hit `FieldIdx::from_u32`'s assertion and caused an ICE; returning `None` for such indices lets normal out-of-bounds lint diagnostics proceed.
analysis.trigger: `KnownPanicsLint` evaluates a `PlaceElem::Index` against `Value::Aggregate` and obtains a constant target-usize index in the range beyond `FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32` but within `u32` range, causing the historical `FieldIdx::from_u32` call to assert.
preconditions: MIR contains constant indexing of an aggregate/array that `KnownPanicsLint` attempts to evaluate.
The index constant is resolvable as a target `usize`.
The index is greater than `FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32` (`0xFFFF_FF00`) and still fits in `u32`, such as `u32::MAX` or `u32::MAX - 1`.
The historical `PlaceElem::Index`/`Value::Aggregate` branch constructs `FieldIdx::from_u32` before validating the range.
pitfalls: A successful `usize` to `u32` conversion does not imply the value is a valid `FieldIdx`; `FieldIdx::from_u32` has a stricter upper bound and asserts on overflow-range values.
Validation must happen before `FieldIdx::from_u32`; the fix uses `FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32`, not merely `u32::MAX`.
For an unrepresentable index, returning `None` preserves the lint's unknown-value path; constructing a fake `FieldIdx` or suppressing the diagnostic would be incorrect.
The failing index can equal or nearly equal `u32::MAX`, so tests should include a value beyond `0xFFFF_FF00`, not just ordinary out-of-bounds indices.
analysis.testStrategy: Add a build-fail UI regression at `tests/ui/indexing/index-bounds.rs` with two constant-index cases: a normal `[64][200]` and the issue case `[64][u32::MAX as usize - 1]`. Assert both emit `unconditional_panic`, and check the high-index stderr reports `index out of bounds: the length is 1 but the index is 4294967294` rather than an ICE. Remove the former `tests/crashes/121126.rs` known-bug case once the behavior is a normal UI diagnostic. This strategy is based on static inspection of the supplied patch; no compiler was built or executed.
evidence: check `idx <= FieldIdx::MAX_AS_U32` before calling `FieldIdx::from_u32` to avoid panic.
